title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Thursday, 24 September 2026
description: Today: Albanese confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents accessed Australia's Medicare database in a first-of-its-kind government hack, as Cisco Talos discloses AI-directed malware; farmers strike a fast-track backpacker visa deal amid Queensland mango harvest concerns; and Gold Coast homicide detectives renew appeals in the 2002 Iain Hogg cold case. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
